description: T-2617: which records a D-function formula condition reads when the criteria (sheet Crit, header Calc, condition on row 2) and the database differ in sheet. Data holds 2^r in A, C, E and 100+r in B, D (no text, so any block is a database); Crit holds r in B and F. Databases on Data start at rows 1, 2, 4, 10 in columns A:C, B:C, D:E (7 rows); conditions H-P are unqualified, Crit-qualified and Data-qualified B2 references plus ROW/CELL diagnostics. DSUM sums the 2^r ids of the matching records, so each answer names the matched rows. Calc rows 121-137 run the same and the T-2553 same-sheet questions (Q-X: two rows above the first record, the header row, a column outside, ranges touching the header) over Crit!A10:C16; rows 138-149 ask what ROW() with no argument is inside a condition (Y-AB). Description of each Calc!A cell in Calc!B.
